symptoms: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
known_issues.cause: Max connections reached; often caused by long-running queries or connection leaks.
known_issues.mitigation: Check pg_stat_activity for long queries; raise max_connections or use pgbouncer.

known_issues.cause: Cache stampede after a cold start or invalidation of hot keys.
known_issues.mitigation: Use cache-aside with probabilistic early expiration or external warm-up job.

known_issues.cause: Consumer crash or stall; messages accumulate because no acks are processed.
known_issues.mitigation: Inspect consumer logs, set prefetch count, and add dead-letter queue.

known_issues.cause: Slow consumers or frequent group rebalances.
known_issues.mitigation: Scale consumers, tune session.timeout.ms, and reduce poll batch size.

known_issues.cause: Deployment rotated signing keys without updating the key-id (kid) resolver.
known_issues.mitigation: Roll back deployment or refresh JWKS endpoint; validate kid before deploy.

known_issues.cause: Upstream processor latency or outage; retries amplify downstream load.
known_issues.mitigation: Add circuit breaker, reduce retry count, and fail fast with user messaging.
